title: Leonurine attenuates OVA-induced asthma via p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Bai, Donghui; Sun, Yujie; Li, Qiong; Li, Haihua; Liang, Yuerun; Xu, Ximing; Hao, Jiejie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究益母草碱通过p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB通路缓解哮喘，分子对接与MD模拟仅针对小分子-蛋白结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Leonurine (Leo) is a natural alkaloid extracted from Herba leonuri, which has many biological activities. However, whether leonurine has a protective effect on asthma remains unknown. The purpose of this study was to investigate the protective effect of leonurine on asthma. We evaluated its therapeutic effect and related signal transduction in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells and OVA-induced asthmatic mice. In addition, we used network pharmacology, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation to verify the experimental results. In LPS-induced RAW 264.7 cells, leonurine significantly reduced the production of TNF-alpha and IL-6, andinhibited the activation of p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. In OVA-induced asthmatic mice, leonurine decreased the number of inflammatory cells in the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), particularly neutrophils and eosinophils. Leonurine also reduced the contents of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 in the BALF and OVA-IgE in the serum. Leonurine remarkly improved OVA-induced inflammatory cell infiltration and significantly inhibited mucus overproduction. In addition, leonurine inhibited the activation of p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in the lung tissues of asthmatic mice. Network pharmacology suggested that p38 MAPKalpha was a potential target of leonurine in the treatment of asthma. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations indicated that leonurine could stably bind to p38 MAPKalpha protein. In summary, leonurine attenuated asthma by regulating p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: Leonurine (Leo) 是从益母草（Herba leonuri）中提取的一种天然生物碱，具有多种生物活性。然而，leonurine 对哮喘是否具有保护作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨 leonurine 对哮喘的保护作用。我们在 LPS 诱导的 RAW264.7 细胞和 OVA 诱导的哮喘小鼠中评估了其治疗效果及相关信号转导。此外，我们使用网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟来验证实验结果。在 LPS 诱导的 RAW 264.7 细胞中，leonurine 显著降低了 TNF-α 和 IL-6 的产生，并抑制了 p38 MAPK/NF-κB 信号通路的激活。在 OVA 诱导的哮喘小鼠中，leonurine 减少了支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中炎症细胞的数量，尤其是中性粒细胞和嗜酸性粒细胞。Leonurine 还降低了 BALF 中 IL-4、IL-5、IL-13 以及血清中 OVA-IgE 的含量。Leonurine 显著改善了 OVA 诱导的炎症细胞浸润，并明显抑制了黏液过度产生。此外，leonurine 抑制了哮喘小鼠肺组织中 p38 MAPK/NF-κB 信号通路的激活。网络药理学提示 p38 MAPKα 是 leonurine 治疗哮喘的潜在靶点。分子对接和分子动力学模拟表明，leonurine 能稳定结合 p38 MAPKα 蛋白。总之，leonurine 通过调节 p38 MAPK/NF-κB 信号通路减轻了哮喘。
